answer: LIST r, n, erf, concat('[', concat(substr(concat(concat( if(trim(se) = 'High', ', {"type": "EnvSensitivity", "value": "High"}', ''), if(trim(sl) = 'High', ', {"type": "LightSensitivity", "value": "High"}', '')), concat( if(trim(st) = 'High', ', {"type": "TempSensitivity", "value": "High"}', ''), if(trim(sh) = 'High', ', {"type": "HumiditySensitivity", "value": "High"}', ''))), 3), ']')) FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataEnvsensitivity se AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity sl AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity st AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity sh AND ALSO ((if(trim(se) = 'High', 10, if(trim(se) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(sl) = 'High', 10, if(trim(sl) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(st) = 'High', 10, if(trim(st) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(sh) = 'High', 10, if(trim(sh) = 'Medium', 5, 1))) / 4) AS erf WHERE erf > 7 ORDERED WITH erf DESCENDING

DEFINE Rk ::= LIST rt, hr, cr FROM Artifactrating rt has ArtifactratingHistsignrating h AND ALSO has ArtifactratingCultscore cu AND ALSO 1 AS k AND ALSO THE RANK OF h WITHIN k AS hr AND ALSO THE RANK OF cu WITHIN k AS cr LIST r, n, iv, cs, cat FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cs AND ALSO is of Artifactsecurityaccess has ArtifactsecurityaccessInsvalueusd iv AND ALSO is of Artifactrating rt AND ALSO rt has Rk RkHr hr AND ALSO rt has cr RkCr cr AND ALSO if(iv > 1000000, 'Monetary High-Value', if(hr * 10 <= THE COUNT OF Artifactrating AND cr * 10 <= THE COUNT OF Artifactrating, 'Cultural/Historical High-Value', 'Other')) AS cat WHERE cs = 'Critical' AND cat <> 'Other'

LIST d, totcpi, nadq, nins, cbe, status FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtdynasty d AND ALSO THE SUM OF v IN (Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cs AND ALSO is of Artifactrating rt AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hg AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rv AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingCultscore cu AND ALSO ((hg + rv + cu) * (10 - if(cs = 'Excellent', 1, if(cs = 'Good', 3, if(cs = 'Fair', 5, if(cs = 'Poor', 7, 10))))) / 30) AS v) GROUPED BY d AS totcpi AND ALSO THE SUM OF v2 IN (Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cs2 AND ALSO is of Artifactrating rt2 AND ALSO rt2 has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hg2 AND ALSO rt2 has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rv2 AND ALSO rt2 has ArtifactratingCultscore cu2 AND ALSO ((hg2 + rv2 + cu2) * (10 - if(cs2 = 'Excellent', 1, if(cs2 = 'Good', 3, if(cs2 = 'Fair', 5, if(cs2 = 'Poor', 7, 10))))) / 30) AS c2 AND ALSO (c2 * c2) AS v2) GROUPED BY d AS sqcpi AND ALSO THE SUM OF v3 IN (Artifactscore is artrefmaintained of Conservationandmaintenance has ConservationandmaintenanceBudgetallocstatus b3 AND ALSO if(b3 = 'Adequate', 1, 0) AS v3) GROUPED BY d AS nadq AND ALSO THE SUM OF v4 IN (Artifactscore is artrefmaintained of Conservationandmaintenance has ConservationandmaintenanceBudgetallocstatus b4 AND ALSO if(b4 = 'Insufficient', 1, 0) AS v4) GROUPED BY d AS nins AND ALSO THE SUM OF v5 IN (Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreConservestatus c5 AND ALSO is artrefmaintained of Conservationandmaintenance has ConservationandmaintenanceBudgetallocstatus b5 AND ALSO if(c5 = 'Critical' AND b5 = 'Insufficient', 1, 0) AS v5) GROUPED BY d AS ncrit AND ALSO THE SUM OF v6 IN (Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry g6 AND ALSO 1 AS v6) GROUPED BY d AS n AND ALSO (sqcpi / (totcpi * n)) AS cbe AND ALSO if(cbe < 0.5 AND ncrit >= 1, 'Budget Crisis', 'Within Budget') AS status

LIST r, n, mt, sl, if(lx > if(sl = 'High', 50, 200), 'Over Exposure', 'Within Limits') FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreMattype mt AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity sl AND ALSO is of Usagerecord has Showcase is of Environmentalreadingscore is of Lightandradiationreading has LightandradiationreadingLightlux lx WHERE sl = 'High' OR sl = 'Medium'

LIST r, n, mt, dd, round(dsd, 2), round(erps, 2), rec FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreMattype mt AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cs AND ALSO is of Artifactrating rt AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hg AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rv AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingCultscore cu AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity sl AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity st AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity sh AND ALSO is of Usagerecord u AND ALSO u has UsagerecordDisplaydurmonths dd AND ALSO u has UsagerecordDisplayrotatesched drs AND ALSO u has Showcase is of Environmentalreadingscore is of Lightandradiationreading lr AND ALSO lr has LightandradiationreadingLightlux lx AND ALSO lr has LightandradiationreadingVisibleexplxh vx AND ALSO if(sl = 'High', 10, if(sl = 'Medium', 5, 1)) AS lw AND ALSO if(st = 'High', 10, if(st = 'Medium', 5, 1)) AS tw AND ALSO if(sh = 'High', 10, if(sh = 'Medium', 5, 1)) AS hw AND ALSO (36 * (10 - lw) * (10 - tw) * (10 - hw) / 1000) AS dsd AND ALSO (lx * lw * vx / 1000) AS ler AND ALSO ((hg + rv + cu) * (10 - if(cs = 'Excellent', 1, if(cs = 'Good', 3, if(cs = 'Fair', 5, if(cs = 'Poor', 7, 10))))) / 30) AS cpi AND ALSO ((dsd - dd) * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100) AS erps AND ALSO if(erps < 0, 'Immediate Rotation', 'Monitor') AS rec WHERE trim(drs) = 'Active'

LIST r, n, tc, rh, hc, if(mdr > 5 AND hc >= 2, 'Yes', 'No') FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtageyears ay AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataEnvsensitivity se AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity sl AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity st AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity sh AND ALSO is of Usagerecord has Showcase is of Environmentalreadingscore e AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempc tc AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreRelhumidity rh AND ALSO ((if(trim(se) = 'High', 10, if(trim(se) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(sl) = 'High', 10, if(trim(sl) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(st) = 'High', 10, if(trim(st) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(sh) = 'High', 10, if(trim(sh) = 'Medium', 5, 1))) / 4) AS erf AND ALSO (if(trim(se) = 'High', 1, 0) + if(trim(sl) = 'High', 1, 0) + if(trim(st) = 'High', 1, 0) + if(trim(sh) = 'High', 1, 0)) AS hc AND ALSO (ay * erf * power(rh - 50, 2) * tc / 100000) AS mdr

LIST sr FROM DISTINCT Showcase has ShowcaseRegistry sr AND ALSO has ShowcaseSealcondition sc AND ALSO has ShowcaseMaintstatus ms AND ALSO has ShowcaseFilterstatus fs AND ALSO has ShowcaseSilicagelstatus gs AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseLeakrate lr AND ALSO is of Environmentalreadingscore e AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempvar24h tv AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreHumvar24h hv WHERE (10 - (tv + hv / 5 + coalesce(lr, 0)) / 3) < 4 OR (if(sc = 'Poor', 1, 0) + if(trim(ms) = 'Overdue', 1, 0) + if(trim(fs) = 'Replace Now', 1, 0) + if(trim(gs) = 'Replace Now', 1, 0)) >= 3

LIST sr FROM DISTINCT Showcase has ShowcaseRegistry sr AND ALSO is of Environmentalreadingscore e AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempvar24h tv AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreHumvar24h hv WHERE tv > 1 OR hv > 3

LIST r, n, d, cpi FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtname n AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtdynasty d AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreConservestatus cs AND ALSO is of Artifactrating rt AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingHistsignrating hg AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingResearchvalrating rv AND ALSO rt has ArtifactratingCultscore cu AND ALSO ((hg + rv + cu) * (10 - if(cs = 'Excellent', 1, if(cs = 'Good', 3, if(cs = 'Fair', 5, if(cs = 'Poor', 7, 10))))) / 30) AS cpi ORDERED WITH cpi DESCENDING

LIST r, round(tetl, 2) FROM Artifactscore has ArtifactscoreArtregistry r AND ALSO has ArtifactscoreArtageyears ay AND ALSO is of Sensitivitydata sd AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataEnvsensitivity se AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataLightsensitivity sl AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataTempsensitivity st AND ALSO sd has SensitivitydataHumiditysensitivity sh AND ALSO is of Usagerecord u AND ALSO u has Showcase is of Environmentalreadingscore e AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreTempc tc AND ALSO e has EnvironmentalreadingscoreRelhumidity rh AND ALSO e is of Lightandradiationreading lr AND ALSO lr has LightandradiationreadingLightlux lx AND ALSO lr has LightandradiationreadingVisibleexplxh vx AND ALSO if(trim(sl) = 'High', 10, if(trim(sl) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) AS lw AND ALSO ((if(trim(se) = 'High', 10, if(trim(se) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + lw + if(trim(st) = 'High', 10, if(trim(st) = 'Medium', 5, 1)) + if(trim(sh) = 'High', 10, if(trim(sh) = 'Medium', 5, 1))) / 4) AS erf AND ALSO (lx * lw * vx / 1000) AS ler AND ALSO (ay * erf * power(rh - 50, 2) * tc / 100000) AS mdr AND ALSO (erf + ler + mdr * 2) AS tetl ORDERED WITH tetl DESCENDING THE FIRST 10
